jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services

• Reporting & Data Visualization: Transform raw data into structured datasets, dashboards and visual reports. Make complex information accessible and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.

• Data Infrastructure Optimization: Contribute to improving data collection processes and data infrastructure to ensure efficient and reliable information gathering.

• A full-time open-ended contract within a strong international group

• The opportunity to work with diverse datasets and contribute to the development of innovative analytical solutions.

• Close collaboration with different business and technical stakeholders.

• Direct reporting to the Data & Insights management team.

If this sounds indeed like your next position, please let us know by applying with your latest CV.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5 years of professional experience in Data Science, Data Analytics or a similar position.

• Strong command of Python and advanced SQL.

• Experience with data visualization and reporting solutions, particularly Power BI.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly adapt to new software and digital tools.
